title: Deployable cross-sectional scorer plan (planned, not yet built)
scope_if_proceed: Freeze the winning feature set + ridge coefficients from the walk-forward.
Wrap a stateless scorer that ingests local price features + PIT fundamentals.
Re-validate on a fully out-of-sample hold-out before any packaging.
hard_constraints: Free SimFin data is delayed ~12 months -> NOT usable for live trading; a deployable scorer needs a non-delayed fundamentals source first.
No orders, no broker execution, no automation, no GCP deploy in 5-F research.
if_not_ready: Keep the Phase 5-C price-only baseline; do not build a fundamentals scorer until incremental edge is demonstrated and a timely data source exists.
